title: Implement quality gate-run state machine, persistence, and API endpoints in Optimize service
creator: Benji Okafor
content:
Context
- Optimize can recommend cost-saving config diffs (batching, KV/prefix cache, quantization profiles). These can materially affect outputs.
- We need a durable, queryable state machine for “gate runs” that can be enforced at apply-time and later wired into rollouts/Console.

Goal
Implement the core gate-run lifecycle inside the Optimize service:
1) A persisted state machine for gate runs (create → execute → pass/fail → optional override)
2) Minimal API endpoints to create and fetch gate runs (Console + rollout controller + apply path)
3) Storage and linking of gate run results/artifacts pointers (artifact IDs/URLs returned by eval-harness)

Non-goals (for this ticket)
- Implementing eval-harness execution itself (ENG-3922)
- Console UI work (ENG-3925)
- Audit log events + override RBAC (ENG-3927, ENG-19537 PR follow-ups)
- Rollout controller enforcement (ENG-3928)

State machine (MVP)
Statuses (string enum):
- PENDING: created, not yet dispatched to eval-harness
- RUNNING: eval-harness job(s) in flight
- PASSED: all required gates passed
- FAILED: at least one required gate failed OR static validation failed
- CANCELED: user/system canceled (e.g., superseded by new diff)
- OVERRIDE_REQUESTED: exception requested with justification (no enforcement change yet)
- OVERRIDDEN: admin-approved time-bound override (treated as “allowed to apply” for a bounded scope)

Notes
- “OVERRIDDEN” is a terminal state for a given gate run; a follow-up gate run should still be created for any new config diff.
- Gate policy evaluation (which gates required by route/tier/config-type) is out of scope for this ticket; assume Optimize provides “required_suites” when creating a run. Per-route policy work tracked in pr-19588.

Persistence
Add new tables (names final per Optimize DB conventions):
- optimize_quality_gate_runs
  - id (uuid)
  - account_id
  - route_id
  - model_id (and model_version if pinned)
  - config_diff_id (points to stored typed diff record)
  - baseline_config_ref (serialized pointer to baseline config/version)
  - gate_tier (smoke|full) (string)
  - status (enum)
  - required_suites (serialized list)
  - created_by (user/service principal)
  - created_at, updated_at
  - started_at, completed_at
  - failure_reason_code (nullable)
  - failure_summary (nullable, short string)
  - eval_harness_run_id (nullable)
  - artifacts_ref (nullable; store as stringified JSON blob for now, or a stable artifact id string)
  - metrics_summary (nullable; store as stringified JSON blob for now)
  - override_expires_at (nullable)
  - override_approved_by (nullable)
  - override_reason (nullable)

- optimize_quality_gate_run_attempts (optional for MVP; implemented as v0)
  - id (uuid)
  - gate_run_id
  - attempt_index
  - status (running|succeeded|failed)
  - started_at, completed_at
  - eval_harness_run_id
  - retry_reason (timeout|infra|flake)

Design trade-off: store metrics_summary/artifacts_ref as opaque strings in v0 to unblock Console and enforcement. Follow-up ticket to normalize into a separate metrics table once metric schema stabilizes.

API surface (internal + Console)
All endpoints are internal-auth (service tokens) for beta; user-level auth to be layered by Console backend.
- POST /v1/optimize/quality-gates/runs
  - Input: account_id, route_id, model_id, config_diff_id, baseline_config_ref, gate_tier, required_suites
  - Behavior: create gate run in PENDING; return id + status
  - Idempotency: accept Idempotency-Key header; dedupe on (account_id, route_id, config_diff_id, gate_tier)

- POST /v1/optimize/quality-gates/runs/{id}:start
  - Behavior: transition PENDING → RUNNING and store started_at
  - Guard: only allowed if currently PENDING

- POST /v1/optimize/quality-gates/runs/{id}:complete
  - Input: status=PASSED|FAILED, failure_reason_code/failure_summary, eval_harness_run_id, artifacts_ref, metrics_summary
  - Behavior: transition RUNNING → terminal; store completed_at + payload

- GET /v1/optimize/quality-gates/runs/{id}
  - Return: full record + opaque metrics/artifacts refs (string)

- GET /v1/optimize/quality-gates/runs?route_id=&config_diff_id=&limit=&cursor=
  - Return: list for Console drill-down + pagination

Important: Apply-time enforcement is implemented in a separate PR (pr-19531). This ticket provides the persisted state used by that enforcement.

Validation & invariants
- Enforce state transitions server-side; reject invalid transitions with explicit error codes:
  - QUALITY_GATE_INVALID_TRANSITION
  - QUALITY_GATE_NOT_FOUND
  - QUALITY_GATE_IDEMPOTENT_CONFLICT
- Ensure “completed” transitions set completed_at once (immutable terminal state except OVERRIDE states, which should be separate endpoints later).
- Ensure RUNNING cannot be entered without eval_harness_run_id once ENG-3922 lands; for MVP allow null and backfill in :complete.

Observability hooks (minimal)
- Emit structured logs on transitions:
  - gate_run_id, from_status, to_status, route_id, account_id, config_diff_id, gate_tier
- Add counters (names aligned with observability standard draft; implementation details in ENG-3926):
  - optimize.quality_gates.run_created
  - optimize.quality_gates.transition
  - optimize.quality_gates.run_terminal

Testing
- Unit tests:
  - valid transitions matrix
  - idempotent create behavior
  - terminal-state immutability
- Integration test stub (full e2e in ENG-19579):
  - create → start → complete(pass) → fetch

Rollout plan
- Feature flag: optimize_quality_gates_state_machine_enabled
- Stage environment first; create runs but do not block apply (enforcement behind separate flag in pr-19531)
- Limited internal accounts: run in parallel with manual process for 1 week; verify stability + correctness before enabling enforcement broadly

Subtasks
- DB migration + backfill script skeleton (no data backfill required; new tables)
- Implement state transition helper (single module) and validate transitions
- Implement POST create + idempotency
- Implement start/complete endpoints
- Implement GET single + list endpoints
- Add logging + minimal metrics hooks (full dashboards/alerts tracked separately)
- Update Optimize service OpenAPI + internal docs

Links
- Confluence PRD: sources/confluence/product-docs/requirements/optimize-quality-guardrails-gating-prd.json
- System design: sources/confluence/product-docs/design-specs/optimize-quality-gates-system-design.json
- Eval integration contract (for payload shape): sources/confluence/applied-ml-and-evals/eval-harness/gating-integration-contracts.json
- Related tickets: ENG-3922, ENG-3925, ENG-3926, ENG-3927, ENG-3928, ENG-3929, ENG-3930

Progress updates / comments
- 2025-11-21 (Jordan Lee): Confirmed state list with Applied ML + PM. Request: keep status strings stable for Console copy and audit export.
- 2025-12-03 (Olivia Grant): Eval-harness will return artifacts_ref + metrics_summary blobs initially. Recommend keeping them opaque strings until metric schema v1 is final.
- 2025-12-10 (Sean Gallagher): Please include started_at/completed_at; we need gate runtime distribution for SLO. Also require transition logs to include route_id.
- 2026-01-08 (Michael Nguyen): Implemented migrations + create/get/list endpoints behind feature flag. Next: idempotency semantics and transition validation table.
- 2026-01-15 (Noah Patel): Ensure FAILED can be set by static validation (ENG-3930) without ever entering RUNNING; recommend allowing PENDING → FAILED transition with failure_reason_code=STATIC_VALIDATION.
- 2026-01-22 (Michael Nguyen): Added PENDING → FAILED path for static validation failures. Wired transition helper and added tests. Ready for review.
- 2026-01-28 (Michael Nguyen): Merged and deployed to staging. Internal beta accounts creating gate runs successfully. Follow-ups filed for metrics normalization + override endpoints (handled in ENG-3927/pr-19537).

Acceptance criteria
- Gate runs are persisted and queryable by id and by (route_id, config_diff_id)
- State transitions are enforced server-side; invalid transitions rejected with clear error codes
- Idempotent create prevents duplicate gate runs for identical input
- Timestamps recorded for start and completion
- Feature-flagged rollout with no impact on existing Optimize behavior when disabled
